scoring_contract.expected_skill_ids: Set of acceptable task-relevant skill IDs; not an instruction to select every listed alternative.
scoring_contract.positive: Require a nonempty selection drawn only from expected_skill_ids; max 3 selections.
scoring_contract.sibling: Require a nonempty selection drawn only from expected_skill_ids; explicitly forbidden siblings must not activate.
scoring_contract.resource: Require empty selection under the supplied unavailable_tools/denied_permissions; score separately from unrestricted semantic routing.
scoring_contract.ambiguous: Empty selection is acceptable; otherwise require all selections to be in expected_skill_ids. Report separately from clear-task accuracy.
scoring_contract.forbidden: A selected forbidden_skill_id is always a failure.
scoring_contract.scope: Only task-directed routing is scored. Always-on system instructions are not inferred as additional selectable skills.
